notes.title: 2025/04/30 Update
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT)
・Increased the experience points gained from Forging.
・Corrected typos and other errors in the Japanese text.
・Fixed an issue where the skill cap for "○○ wound" was not increasing.
・Set the maximum level for "Body blow" and "《Near-death stealth》" to 1.
・Fixed a bug where the cursor position would shift in "Manage companions to transfer."
・Made it so that, just like regular Priests, the location of Priests in the Holy city can also be learned from the Guildmaster.
・Fixed an issue where the skills learned by Gastly were duplicated.
・Fixed an issue where the cursor could shift when choices were displayed in conversation windows and other UI elements.
・Fixed an issue where Abilities were not properly granted to equipment as expected.
・Fixed a bug where NPCs did not automatically replenish their ranged equipment.
・Fixed an issue where the number of Pyroxenes and similar items could sometimes appear in the currency display at the bottom of the item purchase screen and other interfaces.

notes.title: 2025/02/01 Update
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT)
・Enabled setting the Bazaar's BGM as the BGM for My Town.
・Increased the maximum level of the "○○ wound" skill.
・Added items that can be received at the shrine.
・Corrected Japanese text.
・Corrected English text.
・Fixed a bug where repeatedly pressing the enter key quickly while a Unexplored location is displayed would cause the Unexplored location to remain on display.
・Updated the parts of the description in the Japanese tone checker that were outdated.
・Even with save data from before the implementation of the Jewelry table, it can now be placed in My Town from the beginning.
・Adjusted the BGMs available in My Town that had the same names.
・Corrected typographical errors in the Japanese help.
・Fixed a bug where entering a name randomly during an image change in the mirror resulted in a male name regardless of the character's gender.
・Corrected a mistake in the design of the poker cards.

notes.title: 2024/09/17 Update
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT)
・Adjusted each language slightly.
・Added dungeon walls as options for placement in My Town.
・In the Labyrinth of the Abyss, equipment with limited availability will now appear after defeating bosses on certain floors.
・Added the character "ヴ" to the virtual keyboard.
・Fishpond Fish can now be carried over.
・You can now purchase a Lucky Burger at the shrine.
・The status screen now displays the skill slots and the number of abilities.
・Fixed an issue where there were two recipe books for sleeping pills. If you already had the duplicate, it will remain in your inventory, so feel free to discard or keep it as you like.
・Fixed a bug where text in the log would turn black during certain short events.
・Fixed a bug where the game would freeze under specific conditions during the event triggered by not paying tribute to the Demon King.

notes.title: 2024/08/05 Update
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT)
・Added a map where fragments can be converted. It can be accessed in The Place of Beginning.
・Added a cheat mode. You can enable it from the Options per game.
・Adjusted the volume and overlapping sounds when disassembling equipment at the forge.
・Added a record of birth to the "Events" of your child. 
  This feature is effective for children born after this version.
・Added a serial number to the details screen of uploaded content. 
  Providing this number when making inquiries will facilitate smoother communication with the creator.
・You can now check the status of your companions using the up and down keys when opening the status screen from the menu.
・Fixed the ○○ breath to correctly include its intended targets.
・Adjusted Japanese and English translations.
・Fixed an issue in Simplified/Traditional Chinese where incorrect honorifics were used for different genders.

notes.title: 2024/07/15 Update
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT)
・Added tatami floor tiles to My Town.
・Allies with the Dish bag can now retrieve food even outside of town.
・You can now switch shortcuts with the Tab key. 
  Each press of the Tab key cycles through 0-9 → 10-19 → 20-29.
・In Hard difficulty, hunger/sleep damage is no longer taken in town.
・When selecting a destination for dispatching allies, the unlocked monster information is now displayed.
・For Carriage destinations, limited-time maps such as bazaars are prioritized.
・Adjusted the maze map display.
・Adjusted translations in English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.
・When purchasing tactics from the Guild Master, if the next update date is set to an extreme future date for some reason, it will be adjusted.
・Counter skills with renamed skill names now display the renamed names.

notes.title: 2024/07/01 Update
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT)
・Added support for Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
・When taking fish out of the fish tank, if you have a food bag, the fish will be placed in the food bag.
・When receiving materials and other items at the shrine, if you have various bags, the items will be placed in the appropriate bags.
・Added "Only usable by the protagonist" to the descriptions of four items that can only be used by the protagonist.
・Added blacksmith-related objects to the expedition base.
・Enabled changing the appearance on the field from the My Town and Sub Town menus.
・Fixed a bug where taking fish out of the fish tank with more than two pages would cause an error under certain conditions.
・Adjusted English translations.
・After clearing Kanro's event, Kanro will now drop items when defeated.
  (Previously, no items were dropped.)
  (If the event has already been cleared, we apologize, but no items will be dropped.)
・I fixed the issue where the equipment graphics in Manage Content could not be loaded on the Steam Deck.

notes.title: 2024/06/12 update
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT)
・When taking items out of the storage bag, you can now place them on the ground by pressing the space key.
・In "View Abilities," the increase and decrease values of levels due to equipment are now displayed alongside the abilities.
・The experience points gained from smithing now increase (to some extent) based on the number of materials used.
・To make it easier to identify where seeds have been planted, the appearance of planted seed locations has been adjusted.
・You can now set tags in the Original Content Management and search by specified tags.
・High-level requests now occasionally occur at low probabilities.
・Fixed a bug where music skills could not be executed using the option to activate skills from shortcuts without target selection.
・Corrected an issue where abilities such as "Storage" that should not be inherited by your child were being inherited.
・The English text has been adjusted.

Tags can now be edited in Manage Content.
Anyone can set tags for uploaded content.
If you don't mind, we would appreciate it if you could tag each piece of uploaded content　m(_ _)m

notes.title: 2024/05/23 update
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT)
・Added an option to use skills from shortcuts without selecting a target. You can set this in Options(p3).
・Added an item that allows you to pick up all surrounding materials at once. It is randomly sold at the bazaar.
・Added objects that can be placed in My Town.
・When encountering a cleric in the field, you can now stay in place by pressing the cancel key.
・Original content management now counts downloads for adventurers as well. This has been in effect since around May 21, 2024.
・Added four new face graphics.

notes.title: 2024/05/09 update
notes.content:
(Machine translation)

・Added and adjusted text in Japanese and English.
・Added difficulty setting options to the in-game menu. However, these are still being adjusted, so the specifications may change in the future. Additionally, no difficulty adjustments have been made yet, making the early stages particularly challenging.
・Fixed an issue where returning from an expedition with no town to return to no longer causes an error.
・Made it possible to complete the Guild Master's quest even if the boss does not appear.
・Changed the rules so that enemies designated as strong will attack when their behavior pattern might otherwise prevent them from doing so.

notes.title: 2024/05/04 update
notes.content:
(Machine Translation)

・Adjusted the English translation.
・Added instructions on how to enter fullscreen mode when the game is launched for the first time.
・Modified the program to initialize rather than stop with an error when the configuration file is corrupted and cannot be read.

notes.title: 2024/05/02 update
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT)
・For the Windows version, we have added a note to the gamepad settings screen to "Turn off Steam Input."
・In the Windows version, the F11 key has been added for display clipping correction.
・English translations have been updated.
